acceptanceCriteria: Every release-grade measured operation has at least 100 valid warm samples; fewer samples remain diagnostic-only and fail the release-grade comparator.

Captures bind Runtime/binary/repository/toolchain/environment identities and retain raw samples, p50/p95/p99, process counts, execution/reuse counters or explicit unavailable reasons, and invalidation reasons.
Object repositories are read-only inputs; their branches, worktrees, and pre-existing working-tree bytes remain unchanged and are verified after collection.
Runtime latency and Contract-to-reviewable, verification-to-finish, and post-merge-cleanup costs remain separate; absent lifecycle/provider measurements are explicit unknowns, never zero.
No improvement claim is made unless a same-environment paired comparison clears the frozen noise budget; otherwise the result is within_noise or unknown.
The three-language Work Item documents and parity rows state the measurement boundary, read-only object-repository rule, and unknowns consistently without claiming unmeasured improvement.
goal: Produce current-version, same-toolchain performance evidence and separate development-cycle cost evidence; preserve unknowns and do not claim speedup without a noise-clearing comparison.
intent: Measure current Runtime and development-cycle performance with reproducible warm samples on selected object repositories without modifying their main branches.
outOfScope: object repository source trees and their main/default branches
interface SSOT implementation and Outcome host integration
sources: selected object repositories: ORG-X, sentinel, goods-garden, ai-investigation-orchestrator
